summary: Stantec Inc., a Canadian engineering firm, filed Form 6-K on August 12, 2026, containing a press release of its Q2 2026 results. The release reports net revenue of $1.8 billion (up 11.5%), adjusted EBITDA of $332.9 million, diluted EPS of $1.32 and adjusted EPS of $1.61, and a record backlog of $9.2 billion. It also notes the acquisition of Niche, an Australian consultancy, and share repurchases of 1,667,292 shares for $175.9 million in H1 2026. These are routine quarterly results, not a special situation; the acquisitions and buybacks are disclosed as operational updates, not as standalone event filings.
